steps.content: A shabby buggy speeds past, stirring up a cloud of dust. The desert bandits are still in hot pursuit.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Holy cow, you know how to drift?! That's so cool!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Love it! That old dummy drove by the rules... so boring and slow... Finally, I get to enjoy the ride!
Seeing Hella's excited face, the bounty hunter laughs heartily.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Great. There's no one to stop us in WhiteSands. We can drive as fast as we want. Come, little Hella! You hit the gas!
Saying this, Korryn leaps from the driver's seat, grabs Hella by the collar, and drops her in the driver's seat. Then she turns around, gun aimed towards the back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What??? No, no, I've only ever been a passenger! Come back here!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Haha, your short arms are perfect for driving, darling. You'll be fine!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: You are easily a natural, who, like those daredevils, simply won't crash—just floor it and hold tight to the wheel!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I have to show you a grand adventure unique to WhiteSands!
